Now if another cell of emf <math><mi mathvariant="normal">E</mi></math> and internal resistance <math><mn>2</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></math> is connected in parallel to the first cell and balancing length determined, then the balancing length will be-

Since potentiometer doesn't draw any current to measure the emf of the cell, the balancing length will remain the same.
